Headline: Red Line Service Resuming Normal Routing
ShortDescription: Red Line service is resuming its normal routing, via the subway, btwn Fullerton & Cermak-Chinatown after an earlier reroute.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Red Line service is resuming its normal routing, via the subway, between Fullerton & Cermak-Chinatown.

Trains were temporarily rerouted via the elevated lines due to an unauthorized person on the tracks near Clark/Division.

Consider using local bus alternatives through the area where you're traveling, including those to other train lines or where Red Line service has been rerouted to operate.

These may include: 
#29 State
#22 Clark
#36 Broadway

Bus shuttles have been requested from Fullerton to Lake, in both directions to provide service through the affected area, until 4:00pm.

Allow extra travel time.
